properties.summary: WHO published a Disease Outbreak News notice on 20 Nov 2026: Ebola disease caused by Bundibugyo virus, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kenya, Nigeria. WHO's 22nd notice naming Democratic Republic of the Congo in two years. WHO's 3rd notice naming Kenya in two years. WHO's 3rd notice naming Nigeria in two years. WHO publishes a notice after it has verified the event, often weeks after the first report.
